# netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection_list (Data Source)

DeviceClassificationOnPremDetectionList DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection_list" "my_deviceclassificationonpremdetectionlist" {
  limit  = 7
  offset = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number)
- `offset` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `onpremdetection` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--onpremdetection))

<a id="nestedatt--onpremdetection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `onpremdetection`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String) On-prem detection configuration. Key is always "onpremcheck". Example:
  {"onpremcheck": {"onprem_use_dns": "1", "onprem_host": "corp.example.com",
   "onprem_ip": "10.0.0.1", "onprem_http_host": "",
   "onprem_http_tcp_connection_timeout": "10",
   "onprem_additional_ips": [], "onprem_additional_http_hosts": [],
   "onprem_detection_method": "1", "onprem_egress_ips": []}}
Parsed as JSON.
- `name` (String) On-prem detection label name
- `onprem_id` (Number) On-prem detection label ID
- `steering_ids` (List of Number) Steering config IDs associated with this label (computed; managed via steering mapping resource)
